narrative.overview: Learning Line reads like the safety signage of a Japanese car plant: a neutral grey ground, and colour only when something is abnormal or final, keeping each colour's plant meaning (red stop, yellow caution, green safe, blue instruction). Floor screens are large and sparse; desk screens are denser, ruled and tabular.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey ground, white surfaces, charcoal ink
Pill buttons, 8 px panels, ruled tables, tabular numerals

rules.name: The Sign Rule
rules.body: A colour means what it means on a plant sign; otherwise the screen is grey and ink.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Toyota Red only for brand strip, stop and leak-critical.

rules.name: The No Category Colour Rule
rules.body: Loops, categories, selection and progress never take a signal colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures and aligns to its column.

dos: Do keep screens grey until something is abnormal, pending or final
Do show who decided after every human action
Do keep floor targets at 48 px or more, with 72 px primary actions
donts: Don't use red outside stop, leak-critical and the brand strip
Don't use eyebrows, decorative gradients, glass or em-dashes
Don't use the Toyota emblem or Toyota Type
